subject: [hw] IV -> V41: the real vpud answers INIT_DONE but n2ap_venc_open sees -EPROTO (ack ordering; kernel waits the ack before ipi_done)
body:
First real-daemon integration result for n2ap_venc. Host only: V03 loader + V02 core + the full shim set + V40 model, vendor set from gpu/build/cam-vendor-20261109/vfs, 320x240 H.264.

After the guest gets past the V14/V33 stops (in a /tmp copy, not the tree), vpud runs its service loop and the AP call is delivered and answered:

  n2vcu_stats:  set_object=2 get_object=1 allocations=9 gce_flushes=0 unknown=0 ipi_queued=1 ipi_acks=0 log_gets=805506
  daemon ioctl trace (LOCAL fprintf in a /tmp copy of n2vcu.c):
      get_object id=14 len=0        (IPI_VENC_COMMON, blocked, slot VCU_VENC)
      set_object id=0  len=28       (IPI_VCU_INIT message from vpud)
      get_object id=14 len=0        (next iteration = ipi_done, so wait_dispatched returns)
      set_object id=15 len=24       (the INIT_DONE reply, 24 = sizeof vcu_ipi_msg_init)
  n2ap_venc_open -> -EPROTO

Cause (from your code, not guessed): ven_send() checks `!e->reply_seen` immediately after n2vcu_ap_wait_dispatched(). The real vpud fetches the message on its receiver thread, hands it to the service thread and returns to GET_OBJECT at once, so ipi_done (your `dispatched`) is set before the reply arrives; the reply then reaches the handler with `expecting` already cleared.

The kernel does it the other way round (mtk_vcu.c:418-470): vcu_ipi_send clears ipi_id_ack, queues, wakes, then waits `wait_event_timeout(vcu->ack_wq[i], vcu->ipi_id_ack[id], IPI_TIMEOUT_MS)` (the ack IS the daemon reply: vcu_ipi_handler runs the AP handler and sets ipi_id_ack at :1409-1413), and only then does the `while (atomic_read(&vcu->ipi_done[i]) == 0)` loop.

Suggested: in ven_send, after ap_send, wait for `reply_seen` (bounded by the same timeout, polling like ap_wait_dispatched does) and only then call n2vcu_ap_wait_dispatched(); on timeout set aborted=-EIO/-ETIMEDOUT as today. Your fake-daemon test (t_v41_real) cannot see this because its daemon answers synchronously from its GET_OBJECT.

No change asked in V40. This is the only thing between IV and M-d once V14/V33 land; I re-run and post the milestone the same hour.
